name: Susanna
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament

points: “And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” The steward in Herod's own house: people working for Herod were repenting. You think he didn't see that? Susanna was right there, and now she has a head cover and is not eating pork.

“And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward”: I wanted that because some of the women were married, and they continued and supported Christ. “And Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” That’s biblical, sisters, that is biblical; we’re not changing anything.
